findings.desc: doc-code-drift: experiments/recovery-runner/README.md section 'The four tasks' (lines 25-28) still says the corpus is 4 tasks (eval-expr, median, parse-range, text-stats) but the story adds 20 more tasks bringing the total to 24. The section heading, body text, and run-driver.mjs --tasks example (line 99) all describe only the original 4; this directly contradicts the now-frozen 24-task corpus documented in lattice-experiment-protocol.md §2 and the corpus-selfcheck.mjs which validates 24 tasks.
findings.resolvedReason: README 'The four tasks' replaced with the 24-task/8-category stratified-corpus table; payload-file note corrected. Commit d0f7d97cc.

findings.desc: doc-code-drift: experiments/recovery-runner/README.md line 112 shows the run-selfchecks.mjs comment as 'adjudicate + checks + spend-accounting + run-driver + analyze selfchecks' (5 items). After this story, run-selfchecks.mjs SELFCHECKS array has 6 entries with corpus-selfcheck.mjs added (confirmed in code). The README comment is stale and does not mention corpus-selfcheck.mjs, misrepresenting the scope of 'npm test'.

CHK-001:edge:0 lacks valid verificationEvidence: the intent requires git diff to verify the 4 pre-existing task dirs (eval-expr/median/parse-range/text-stats) are unmodified, but the bound evidence (node experiments/recovery-runner/corpus-selfcheck.mjs) performs no git operations and would pass even if those 4 dirs were modified; corpus-selfcheck only checks file presence + task.json well-formedness, not git-level diff.

CHK-001:happy:1 evidence does not cover payload-subtle.mjs presence: the intent states "all 7 contract files exist (task.json, prompt.md, acceptance.mjs, reference-solution.mjs, ground-truth.mjs, payload-subtle.mjs, subtle-wrong-output.mjs)" but corpus-selfcheck.mjs intentionally excludes payload-subtle.mjs from its REQUIRED array (line 47-58) because 3 of the 24 tasks use inline payloads instead; the bound evidence command (node corpus-selfcheck.mjs) would pass even if payload-subtle.mjs were absent from a new task dir, silently under-counting the 7-file contract.

CHK-001:adversarial:0 lacks valid verificationEvidence: the intent requires verifying "no extra files beyond the 7-file contract in any new task dir (no .DS_Store, node_modules, .bak, etc.)" via a find command, but corpus-selfcheck.mjs only asserts that the REQUIRED 6 files exist; it never enumerates actual directory contents against an allowlist and would pass even with extra junk files present.

CHK-002:edge:0, CHK-002:edge:1, CHK-002:adversarial:0, CHK-003:edge:0, CHK-003:edge:1, CHK-003:adversarial:0, CHK-003:adversarial:1, CHK-004:edge:1, CHK-004:adversarial:0 share a pattern gap: all these intents describe mutation/destructive scenarios ("remove a contract file → exits non-zero", "replace reference-solution with broken impl → exits non-zero", "tamper inject() to no-op → exits non-zero", "add 25th task → exits non-zero", "remove corpus-selfcheck from disk → exits non-zero", etc.) but all bound evidence uses the same normal run command (node corpus-selfcheck.mjs or node run-selfchecks.mjs) without the described mutation; the evidence notes claim the code logic would catch the mutation, but the actual mutant scenario was never exercised; this is a broad description ("the check detects X") not a concrete command that produced the described outcome.

corpus-selfcheck anti-gaming invariant is not tamper-proof against a gamed task: it copies acceptance.mjs+ground-truth.mjs, runs the reference, then calls untrusted task-local inject() and re-runs the SAME copied harness files without re-copying/re-hashing them or constraining what inject() may write. Trigger: a malicious subtle-wrong-output.mjs could write a correct solution.mjs AND overwrite the scratch ground-truth.mjs to print GROUND-TRUTH FAIL + exit nonzero, satisfying the invariant with NO real buried payload bug. Current tasks only write task.outputFile (not exploited today) but the machine invariant itself is unsound. Fix: re-copy pristine acceptance.mjs+ground-truth.mjs after inject() (or snapshot+assert inject only modified solution.mjs / no harness writes).

corpus-selfcheck is not reentrant: SCRATCH is a fixed global path (tmpdir()/corpus-selfcheck-scratch) rmSync'd at startup, so two concurrent runs collide (reproduced: one process exits 1 with ENOTEMPTY at the startup rmSync, the other passes). Fix: use mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(),'corpus-selfcheck-')) for a unique per-run scratch dir.
